"""Database connection options schemas."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

@dataclass
class ConnectionOptions:
    dsn: str
    pool_params: Dict[str, Any]
    max_overflow: int = 10
    timeout_seconds: float = 30.0

    def is_ssl(self) -> bool:
        return "sslmode" in self.pool_params

    def get_param(self, key: str, fallback: Any = None) -> Any:
        return self.pool_params.get(key, fallback)

    def summary(self) -> str:
        return f"Pool(dsn={self.dsn}, params={len(self.pool_params)})"
=== END ===

"""Database pool manager."""
from typing import Dict, Any
from env_loader import merge_env_settings
from options import ConnectionOptions

def configure_pool(base_template: Dict[str, Any], overrides: Dict[str, Any]) -> ConnectionOptions:
    """Configure connection pool options from template and overrides.
    Returns ConnectionOptions instance.
    """
    settings = merge_env_settings(base_template, overrides)
    dsn = settings.get("dsn", "sqlite:///:memory:")
    pool_params = settings.get("pool", {})
    opts = ConnectionOptions(dsn=dsn, pool_params=pool_params)
    _ = opts.summary()
    return opts
=== END ===

"""Environment settings loader and merger."""
from typing import Dict, Any

DEFAULT_CONN_TIMEOUT = 30

def load_system_env() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"timeout": DEFAULT_CONN_TIMEOUT}

def merge_env_settings(base_settings: Dict[str, Any], override_settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    merged = dict(base_settings)
    merged.update(override_settings)
    return merged

import pytest
from pool import configure_pool

def test_pool_defaults_isolation():
    # Test that default values are not shared across configurations
    base1 = {"dsn": "pg://db1", "pool": {"min": 5}}
    base2 = {"dsn": "pg://db2", "pool": {"min": 10}}
    
    # Configure two separate pools
    opts1 = configure_pool(base1, {})
    opts2 = configure_pool(base2, {})
    
    # Verify that the default values are independent
    assert opts1.max_overflow == 10  # Default value
    assert opts2.max_overflow == 10  # Default value, not corrupted by opts1
    
    # Also test that we can override independently
    override1 = {"pool": {"max": 20}}
    override2 = {"pool": {"max": 30}}
    
    opts1_override = configure_pool(base1, override1)
    opts2_override = configure_pool(base2, override2)
    
    assert opts1_override.max_overflow == 20  # Overridden value
    assert opts2_override.max_overflow == 30  # Overridden value
    assert opts1_override.timeout_seconds == 30.0  # Default value
    assert opts2_override.timeout_seconds == 30.0  # Default value
=== END ===

from pool import configure_pool

def test_basic_pool_config():
    opts = configure_pool({"dsn": "pg://prod", "pool": {"min": 5}}, {"pool": {"max": 20}})
    assert opts.dsn == "pg://prod"
